decisions.reason: The high-pressure geothermal probe extends the firm's established tube business into a growing heat-pump and geothermal market, so results likely meet aspirations and slack lets the firm carry it.
The single-U borehole heat exchanger is a standard product within the geothermal line, and demand rose with the German heating transition, so there is no shortfall to trigger search.
The surface technology line with several models differentiates the geothermal probes and uses the firm's materials expertise, so keeping it fits a satisfactory performance trajectory.
Fire-protection steel profiles meet regulatory demand close to the core profile business, and construction remained strong through 2021, so results likely exceed aspiration.
The slim profile system is a close extension of the established offer, with low marginal cost and demand from architects for slim facades and windows.
The decorative surface system is more of a niche option with less certain volume, but organisational slack in a large firm allows it to be kept as a complement to the profile range.
